name: Maretta Dias
source:
Lieutenant Maretta Dias is an engineering technical specialist. She is also [url=https://vndb.org/c14806]Lai Wong[/url]'s right-hand girl. Despite her innocuously pretty looks, she is quite competent. Maretta makes sure that Lai Wong's orders are followed to the letter and without question.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url]]
